hypothesis: Conditional long-only recovery of an unusually negative stock-minus-sector 60-minute opening shock, with a fixed cost-aware recovery hurdle, improves net continuous equity against CASH, a threshold-off stock control and same-event sector control. This is not a hedged cointegration or OU strategy.
source_classification: Fresh Alpaca receipt capture of a period previously used globally by HARPOON; different from30.17 family but NOT globally virgin or confirmatory.
universe_limitations: XLK holds AAPL/MSFT, so benchmark is not independent
Two surviving stocks, not point-in-time all-listings universe

estimator.method: Univariate OLS with intercept on aligned open-to60minute log returns in fixed TRAIN; no daily-to-intraday beta extrapolation
estimator.sigma: Sample standard deviation of regression residual, ddof1; degenerate<1e-6 refuses model, not rescaled fiction
estimator.fit_count: One fit perstock plus exact verification/reproduction; no hyperparameter search

decision.clock: session.open+60minutes+1000ms; bar ending+60min assumed available+1000ms; planned fill open+65min
decision.entry_price: Future open used only to resolve ex ante IOC ceiling; never for feature/sizing
decision.ranking: Minimum valid residual z amongAAPL/MSFT, alphabetical tie; one proposed stock per session
decision.drift: Abs(z)>8 refuses that stock for every policy, not a tradeable extreme
decision.recovery_score: 0.5*(mu-residual) is hypothetical partial recovery, NOT a calibrated expected return or probability
decision.cost_scope: No forward training label; modeled roundtrip friction enters admission estimate and is charged only by execution ledger, not deducted twice from cash
decision.stop: ATR14 from previous completed regular sessions, split-adjusted to decision share units; floor2ticks
decision.execution_template: CLOSED_CHANNEL:BASELINE solely for common native<=72hour exits; economic signal identity remains INTRADAY_SECTOR_RESIDUAL_RECOVERY

policies.RESIDUAL_LONG: Selected stock only when z<=-1.5 and fixed cost hurdle passes
policies.STOCK_THRESHOLD_OFF: Same daily stock ranking/time/validity, but no z-entry threshold or recovery hurdle; ablation, not unconditional or market-neutral
policies.SECTOR_TIMING_CONTROL: XLK at the same proposed events admitted by RESIDUAL_LONG in each cost scenario; same risk budgets but not exactly beta/notional/holding matched
policies.CASH: No positions; same fixed session costs; derived reference

risk_contract.cash_dividends: Accrued ex-date rights, payable-date cash; split crossing and missing tape remain core fail-closed contracts

data_admission.request_partition: One symbol per calendar month; limit10000; final month ends2026-10-16T23:59:59Z
data_admission.calendar_grid: Every expected5minute RTH slot for all3symbols; no forward fills or synthetic prices
data_admission.unexpected_next_page_or_count_at_limit: REJECT_TRUNCATION; narrow interval only, never silently accept incomplete
data_admission.missing_bar_policy: At most2 targeted recapture attempts per missing interval using samefeed/symbol/time; otherwise DATA_BLOCKED, no invented no-fill
data_admission.price_adjustment: Tool has no adjustment parameter; retain documented endpoint raw default as assumption, not certification
data_admission.corporate_action_dates: process_date filter is not ex_date completeness; preserve all returned types and flags; effective dates conditional, original announcement receipts unknown
data_admission.unsupported_affecting_action: Fail closed for unresolved action in study universe/period
data_admission.prepared_old149_raw_missing: Do not treat retained prepared artifact as reconstruction from original provider receipts; fresh captures must be retained and hashed

statistics.risk_checks: Event-mark drawdown<=8%,close-to-close daily loss<=2%; no tick-level guarantee

stopping_rule: Exactly6policy/cost measurements+2CASHderived and one exact reproduction. Retain negative/sparse/refused results. No newthreshold,window,asset orperiod after returns. If rawcoverage fails, finish fail-closed admission/pipeline and report minimum original-data requirement; do not fabricate alpha.

requirements: Freeze exact recipe and model/code identity before first observed decision
Original bar/quote first-received timestamps before decision, no modeled historical receipt promotion
Cost/fill evidence or explicitly conditional paper model; broker invoices/actualfills needed for real economics
Enough sessions and independent evidence;20trades alone not proof
forward_plan.action_on_negative_historical_result: Do not promote; pipeline can admit real records but does not grant strategy or trading approval

methodological_sources.use: Inspiration only; hedged strategy and roughly7day reversion do not validate our60minute shock entry/<=72hour long-only exit
